newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIA ACCEPTS CYPRUS NEW DATE FOR WORLD QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIA ACCEPTS CYPRUS NEW DATE FOR WORLD QUALIFIER.

text.p: The Bulgarian Football Union said on Thursday it has accepted a proposal from Cyprus to change the day of their World Cup qualifier to December 14 from December 15, which would have clashed with elections in Cyprus.
An under 21 game will be played on December 13, union spokesman Nikola Exerov told Reuters. He said the date change should be approved by soccer's ruling body FIFA.
Bulgaria's head coach Hristo Bonev is relying on a victory against Cyprus to keep alive hopes of qualifying for the World Cup finals.
Volatile striker Hristo Stoichkov, who plays for Barcelona, may not play again after he vowed to quit the national side unless the BFU chiefs resigned.
Stoichkov missed Bulgaria's two World Cup qualifiers. Bulgaria lost 2-1 in their opening European group five qualifying match in Israel and managed to win against Luxembourg.
The football union will hold an extraordinary congress on December 20 to discuss appointing new management.
